question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**the**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage is 'Traffic Congestion'.
 
• The most appropriate article for the given blank is '**the**'.
 
• We always use the** definite article** ‘**the**’ before a **superlative** **degree** **adjective**(‘**biggest**’ in the given sentence). 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *For an average Indian, driving in any of the major Indian cities is equivalent to waging a daily war. The everyday struggle of dodging traffic, pollution and rash drivers is **the** biggest cause of chronic stress and other (4) ______ problems. On an average a person spends (5) ______ between thirty minutes to two hours of their day driving.*
